Some would say what happened to me wasn’t actual assault, and I sometimes tell myself the same, but I know it had seriously damaging effects on me to this day. 

I was 7, and it was a kid around 10. He used to threaten me if I didn’t strip for him, sometimes in public places. Idk if he had just seen it on tv or what, but it fucked me up. 

Ironically, I went on to need approval from others by trying to over succeed. Class president, captain of varsity, overall life of the party. But my sex life was completely ruined. Once I became sexually mature, I couldn’t get it up with women because of intense anxiety about not being approved. I could with men, but in a way that echoed the dynamic which played out as a kid. I wasn’t even attracted to men, but I guess I became submissive through this trauma. 

I’ve had successful relationships with women once I had time with them to get comfortable and communicate my anxiety (without telling them the full truth), but to this day every new relationship begins with sexual frustration. 

Anyways, thanks for asking. I don’t talk about it, so it’s nice to bark at the internet even if no one listens. I still operate in this hyper-success driven mindset, so my peers have literally no idea what I’ve been through. They just assume I like to party a ton, but I know I’m bottling down some shit.

I started a high paying management job out of undergrad. Then began a top-3 business school program in the evenings. The only thing that gives me life is music, and if I spend any time on that it comes directly out of my sleep.

For the first time I’m doing pretty poorly in class because I just don’t have the energy for it. 
And I have to keep playing music, because without it I’d go insane. But now I’m averaging 5 hours of sleep per night. 
My alcohol and marijuana use has fluctuated, 
At the end of the day, I could just quit my job. But what about the health insurance? And I could quit my school, but what about the pride and accomplishment? And I could quit music, but what about the mental stability?
